provenance_caveat: Original Qv9 ARC train24 and diag24 have previously been examined in Qv9 research; Qv10 train/diagnostic are disjoint within task but NOT pristine untouched research-level holdout. Newly pinned RACE validation is exploratory and should not be tuned on.
selection: SHA256(revision+'/'+example_id+'/'+question) sorted; 4 original A/B/C/D options; one question per unique RACE article/example_id; complete untruncated article/question/options Qwen ChatML <=208 tokens; 4 distinct exact one-token answer choices
model_output_grouping: Seven grouped logits: A,B,C,D letter logits, highest 2 non-letter logits at original BF16 full-vocab next-token forward, logsumexp of every other vocabulary logit as one OTHER bin. Group probabilities exactly normalize to original full-vocab mass and each bin's gradient is well-defined; collapsing OTHER loses within-bin curvature.
gradient_reuse: Preserve previous original Qv9 signed BF16 projection gradients of z_A-z_D,z_B-z_D,z_C-z_D. Recheck original conditional four-letter probabilities against new original BF16 model logits.
new_source_gradient: Exactly three new BF16 backward passes per source example: top1-D, top2-D, logsumexp(other vocab)-D; project against identical 196 BEGLIN C Q4/n8 signed residuals; keep source and diagnostic groups apart.
weight_error_residual_source: original native C Q4G64 and n8 group64, intermediate FP16 residual, BF16 MPS gradient, FP64 signed dot
objective: KL(original grouped full-vocab BF16 probabilities || softmax(log original grouped probabilities + first-order grouped Δ logits)); robust max(12 even train,12 odd train); trust=0.05 E_p[max(0,abs(Δlogit)-2)^2]; isolated output-grouped Gauss-Newton ridge=0.10 per tensor /196.
source_optimization: fixed source-only starts Qv6_Fisher64,Qv6_Fisher128,Qv9_GGN24; hard exactly 28/196 n8; same original measured Apple CPU memory<=830570496 B, serial<=100ms, async stage<=50ms; seeded strictly feasible one-swap coordinate search, no global optimality
policy_use_safety_gate: If source diagnostic24 has no lower grouped KL/trust score than original Q4 or Fisher64, deny candidate promotion; do NOT refit on diagnostic or RACE. All cases deny live promotion regardless.
original_BF16_reference: original pinned Qwen on PyTorch MPS, nonidentical numeric backend to native widened F32
quality_metrics: 48-question correct single-token full-vocabulary NLL and accuracy over A/B/C/D, native Qwen 28-layer BEGLIN Apple C fullmodel
statistical_method: paired 5000 bootstrap CI seed 20261023; subject/passage stratification not needed because one question per article; exploratory inference
hypothesis: Compared with output-only 4 candidate GGN surrogate, preserving top-token plus OTHER fullvocab probability and penalizing large predicted shifts MAY be more robust; must fail closed when not measured.
novelty_claim: No first-to-invent claim for top-k, curvature, logit matching, or trust regions. Kernel-cost+policy+source/provenance integration only research contribution.
